Executable is the validated OS command processor. mklink, /J and switches are fixed; paths derive from the test-owned TemporaryDirectory plus fixed leaf names, and both resolved parents must match the fixture root. check=True, capture_output, ten-second timeout and CREATE_NO_WINDOW remain. This narrow classification assumes a trusted local test environment and does not assert safety against a compromised same-user process or OS.
